changes_made.explanation: Added Text Classification as it's evaluated alongside NLG tasks. Removed datasets that are actually models/architectures. Normalized model names and output descriptions for consistency.
Simplified variants to base metric forms (ROUGE Drop Percentage → ROUGE, CLIP Drop Percentage → CLIP). ASR is correctly extracted as Attack Success Rate.
CoEdIT-XXL is used as a defense mechanism, not as an evaluator/judge of generated outputs. The paper does not use LLMs as judges for evaluation purposes.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are performed using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper proposes an adversarial attack method (CEMA) against multi-task models, evaluating primarily on NLG tasks (translation, summarization, text-to-image generation) alongside classification tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but included some non-NLG models/datasets that needed filtering. The paper focuses on attack effectiveness measured by automatic metrics rather than quality evaluation of generated outputs.
